about_the_game:
Try the Digital Eclipse: Cyberpunk Survivor Demo!

Step into a neon-drenched bullet hell and test your survival instincts in this high-intensity, co-op action roguelike demo.

This demo offers a limited, yet action-packed slice of the full experience:

  • Character Level Cap: 45 (Full game goes up to 200)

  • Weapons can be purchased, but only upgraded to Tier 1 (Full game allows 3-tier upgrades for deeper build progression)

  • Explore 10 unique maps spread across 5 districts (Full version features 20 maps and expanded mission variety)

  • Multiplayer Co-op Support: Jump in with friends and survive the cybernetic swarm together; demo players are matched separately from full-version players.

  • Create up to 3 characters (Full version supports up to 10 character slots)

  • No Steam Achievements in the Demo (Available in the full game)

This is a taste of the chaos, the upgrades, and the grind, enough to hook you and get you ready for the full-scale war against Synthex Prime.

Digital Eclipse: Cyberpunk Survivor launches this August. Wishlist the full game now and take the fight further.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game features stylized combat with frequent gunfire, explosions, and blood effects as players fight through waves of robotic and cybernetic enemies. While intense, all violence is presented in a sci-fi, arcade-like style without realistic gore or dismemberment.

There is no sexual content, drug or alcohol use, self-harm, or any form of abuse depicted in the game.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: VIDIA GTX 1050 Ti (4GB) / AMD RX 570 (4GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

  • Processor: Intel i5-9400F / AMD Ryzen 5 2600

  • Graphics: GTX 1660 Super (6GB) / RX 5600 XT (6GB)
